metrics.answerText:
**Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict from the independent lab reports**

I read the recall brief, all three dossiers, and each dossier's linked independent lab report.

**Supported: bearing seat machining.** The lab measured bearing seats on **every recalled batch machined 0.4 mm undersize** — "This theory is SUPPORTED." ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33881/lab-bearing))

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure.** Coating cure times were **within tolerance on every recalled batch** — "This theory is NOT supported." ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33881/lab-coating))

**Ruled out: packaging compression.** Packaging **matched spec on every recalled batch** — "This theory is NOT supported." ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33881/lab-packaging))

Sources: [recall brief](http://127.0.0.1:42279/recall-brief) · dossiers: [coating](http://127.0.0.1:42279/theory-coating), [bearing](http://127.0.0.1:42279/theory-bearing), [packaging](http://127.0.0.1:42279/theory-packaging)
